description: EWELD: A Large-Scale Industrial and Commercial Load Dataset in Extreme Weather Events is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Guolong Liu et al. Load forecasting informs economic and secure power system operation. Extreme weather events, such as extreme heat and typhoons, can lead to more significant fluctuations in power consumption, making load forecasting more difficult. Coverage: not stated; published in 2023. Formats: CSV, Excel. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 258090540 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
